citations.claim: At first violation step E is red with queue 61 and wait 201, NS green
One step earlier E red wait 200 at threshold, NS still green
E has been red since NS green started around step 430, wait growing
NS green persists past max_green with S detector failed, E wait 85+ growing

counterfactual.change: Changed actuated true->false only; fixed-time cycle then terminates NS green on schedule so E gets green and no max_wait violation.

explanation: Actuated NS green started ~step 430 and was still held at step 627 (~197s, well over max_green 86s). While S detector_fail active from t=511 the controller cannot see S queue and mis-handles gap-out/max-out/recall: it keeps serving NS (N has real queue 54-59) and never recalls to EW, so E waits red with queued vehicles from wait 4 to 201, breaching max_wait 200. Fixed-time control of identical demand terminates the green and avoids the violation.

violation.detail: approach 1 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The intersection is frozen across steps 624 to 627 with long blue queues backed up on the approaches and no vehicles discharging through the crossing. One direction keeps the right-of-way while the cross direction stays stopped with its queue intact, starving waiting traffic.
